review_comments: c.curr should be set to nil here
This doesn't look correct, there's nothing that requires that the first iterator in the slice has the sample with the lowest timestamp.
True, but we don't care that much, it's just nice to have it set to something so we don't need to care to do if curr != nil
Don't we need to push&pop/fix here so that c.curr is updated?
Not required. It will follow the same loop and compare the next in the curr with the top of the heap and do the push and pop if required.
If we've gotten here, isn't this always going to be true?
We come here when either curr is exhausted or it has crossed the top of the heap. It is possible that the top of the heap has the same timestamp as the lastt.

All should work, but I am not huge fan of checking duplicates within a chunk/single iterator itself :thinking: 

Let me benchmark it if it has any overhead...
